title: Resurgent structure of the 't Hooft-Polyakov monopole
summary: In this letter we present a comprehensive analysis of the differential equations governing the spatial profile of the 't~Hooft-Polyakov monopole from the viewpoint of resurgence theory. We note that the universality of the gauge-component asymptotics, together with the relative simplicity of its Borel transform and the associated Volterra equations' kernels, gives rise to a perturbative expansion featuring a good control over the proliferation of the Borel-plane singularities to all orders, along with full information about the relevant logarithmic discontinuities.
